solver_wrappers.name: resetDefGradForOversizedParticles
solver_wrappers.description: Compatibility flag for resetting deformation gradient of particles whose current domain diagonal exceeds the configured grid-cell ratio. Equivalent to oversizedParticleTreatment="resetDeformationGradient" when oversizedParticleTreatment is left at "none". Use only for materials where the stored deviatoric deformation gradient is not constitutive state, such as fluids, melted material, fully damaged material, or hypo-elastic deviatoric models; do not enable for finite-strain hyperelastic, crystal-plasticity, fiber, or other orientation/stretch-history-dependent solids unless the material model explicitly supports this reset.

solver_wrappers.name: oversizedParticleTreatment
solver_wrappers.description: Action for particles whose current domain diagonal exceeds defGradResetMaxParticleDomainToGridCellRatio. "none" preserves the legacy resetDefGradForOversizedParticles flag, "resetDeformationGradient" resets F, and "split" uses the particle subdivision path unless the rank particle-count threshold requests reset fallback. Allowed values are "none", "resetDeformationGradient", and "split".

solver_wrappers.name: oversizedParticleResetRankParticleCountThreshold
solver_wrappers.description: Rank-local total particle-count threshold for oversizedParticleTreatment="split". Oversized particles are split while the rank count is less than or equal to this value, and deformation-gradient reset is used only on ranks whose count exceeds it. A negative value disables the reset fallback.

solver_wrappers.name: defGradResetMaxParticleDomainToGridCellRatio
solver_wrappers.description: Maximum full particle-domain diagonal divided by active grid-cell diagonal before optional oversized-particle treatment. Deformation-gradient reset fallback is intended for the same fluid, melted, damaged, or hypo-elastic material classes as resetDefGradForOversizedParticles.

solver_wrappers.name: surfaceNormalAndPositionDamageThreshold
solver_wrappers.description: Sets the damage threshold at which explicit particle surface normals, positions, and tractions are disabled

solver_wrappers.name: surfaceQualityThreshold
solver_wrappers.description: Minimum mapping-normal tensor quality required for same-group DFG separability. Valid range is [0,1]; 0 disables the quality restriction and 1 requires a fully coherent, fully covered normal.

solver_wrappers.name: surfaceTensionForceSign
solver_wrappers.description: Sign multiplier for the grid continuum-surface-stress force. Leave at +1; set to -1 only when validating against an opposite normal/color convention.

solver_wrappers.name: surfaceTensionGradientTolerance
solver_wrappers.description: Lower bound for |grad color| used to regularize surface-tension normals. Units are inverse length. A non-positive value selects an automatic value.

solver_wrappers.name: surfaceTensionPairs
solver_wrappers.description: Rows of { phaseA, phaseB, gamma }. Phases are particleGroup/contact-group ids. Use phaseB=-1 for a phase-void/free-surface pair. gamma has units of force/length.

solver_wrappers.name: thinFeatureDFGThreshold
solver_wrappers.description: Suppresses DFG separability when the squared distance between field centers is less than (thinFeatureDFGThreshold * neighborRadius)^2.

solver_wrappers.name: totalBinderVolume
solver_wrappers.description: Total volume of binder

solver_wrappers.name: updateMethod
solver_wrappers.description: Update method. Options are:; * ; *

solver_wrappers.name: updateOrder
solver_wrappers.description: Order for update method, only applies to XPIC and FMPM

solver_wrappers.name: useCrackTipDetection
solver_wrappers.description: Set to activate crack-tip detection and distance calc

solver_wrappers.name: useEvents
solver_wrappers.description: Enable events

solver_wrappers.name: useInternalForceAsFaceReaction
solver_wrappers.description: Will use internal force component at boundary node as reaction

solver_wrappers.name: useNodePosForArea
solver_wrappers.description: Option to compute nodal area from grid surface normals and positions (results may be inaccurate if implicit surface normals and positiosn are used)

solver_wrappers.name: useReferenceVectorsForParticleUpdate
solver_wrappers.description: Flag for determining the integration scheme of particle vector attributes

solver_wrappers.name: useSurfacePositionForContact
solver_wrappers.description: Flag for to use particle mapped surface positions in contact calculations

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTraceGapStabilization
solver_wrappers.description: Optional beta stabilization on the prescribed weak-interface trace gap.

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTraceMaxGapCorrectionVelocity
solver_wrappers.description: Maximum magnitude of the weak-interface trace accumulated-gap correction velocity. A zero value disables the cap.

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTraceMinWeight
solver_wrappers.description: Minimum active trace support weight required on each side of a weak-interface trace projection.

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTracePairs
solver_wrappers.description: Optional contact-group pairs for weak-interface trace projection. Empty means all group pairs.

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTraceProjectionIterations
solver_wrappers.description: Number of local Jacobi iterations for the weak-interface trace projection. Values greater than one reduce slip without using a full one-shot projection.

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTraceProjectionScale
solver_wrappers.description: Under-relaxation scale alpha for each weak-interface trace projection impulse.

solver_wrappers.name: weakInterfaceTraceSuppressNodalContact
solver_wrappers.description: Skip ordinary nodal contact for contact-group pairs handled by weak-interface trace projection.

solver_wrappers.name: timeIntegrationOption
solver_wrappers.description: Time integration method. Options are:; * ; *

solver_wrappers.name: tracerCoordinates
solver_wrappers.description: Coordinates used to initialize MPM lagrangian tracers. Each row is x,y,z; each tracer follows the nearest particle selected during initialization.

solver_wrappers.name: tracerCycleInterval
solver_wrappers.description: Cycle interval for MPM lagrangian tracer CSV output. Use either tracerCycleInterval or tracerWriteInterval. A value of 0 means no cycle-based interval.

solver_wrappers.name: tracerHistory
solver_wrappers.description: Flag to enable MPM lagrangian tracer CSV output. One CSV file is written per tracer point.

solver_wrappers.name: tracerOutputPrefix
solver_wrappers.description: Filename prefix for MPM lagrangian tracer CSV files.

solver_wrappers.name: tracerParticleIDs
solver_wrappers.description: Particle global IDs selected for MPM lagrangian tracers.

solver_wrappers.name: tracerVariables
solver_wrappers.description: Particle variables to write to each MPM lagrangian tracer CSV file. Supported names include particleID, mass, volume, materialType, porosity, density, damage, temperature, internalEnergy, kineticEnergy, speed, velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ, plasticStrainMagnitude, stressXX, stressYY, stressZZ, stressYZ, stressXZ, stressXY, and plasticStrainXX/YY/ZZ/YZ/XZ/XY.

solver_wrappers.name: tracerWriteInterval
solver_wrappers.description: Time interval for MPM lagrangian tracer CSV output. Use either tracerWriteInterval or tracerCycleInterval. A value of 0 means no time-based interval.

event_data.name: RigidBodyMPM
event_data.description: Activates color-partitioned rigid-body MPM between startTime and endTime. One rigid body is formed from all particles sharing a particleColor value. ParticleColor is independent of ContactGroup: any number of bodies may share one catch-all contact group, and maxGridFields limits only the local nodal color multiplicity rather than the global number of bodies.

attributes.name: startTime
attributes.description: Time at which event starts

attributes.name: endTime
attributes.description: Time at which event ends

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Delay between dependencies being complete and starting the event

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Time at which event ends

attributes.name: dependencies
attributes.description: List of the names for event dependencies

attributes.name: hasStarted
attributes.description: Flag for whether event has started

attributes.name: isComplete
attributes.description: Flag for whether event has been completed

attributes.name: maxGridFields
attributes.description: Maximum number of local nodal velocity fields used for rigid-body color partitioning. The first maxGridFields-1 colors are mapped to pure fields; additional colors are lumped into the last field with weighted force attribution. This value limits local color multiplicity only: dozens or hundreds of global particleColor bodies may share one catch-all ContactGroup without increasing the nodal field allocation.

attributes.name: linearDamping
attributes.description: Rigid-body linear viscous damping rate applied after force integration.

attributes.name: angularDamping
attributes.description: Rigid-body angular viscous damping rate applied after torque integration.

attributes.name: contactCFL
attributes.description: Optional rigid-event-only contact CFL. When positive, the rigid event time step is limited by contactCFL * h / max(2*maxParticleSpeed, maxParticleSpeed + maxBoundarySpeed). Nonpositive values disable this additional limiter.

attributes.name: maxTimeStep
attributes.description: Optional rigid-event-only maximum time step. Nonpositive values disable this cap. The continuum MPM time-step calculation is unchanged.

attributes.name: rigidBodyPenetrationPenaltyBeta
attributes.description: Dimensionless rigid-event-only penetration penalty coefficient. For material contact, the normal penalty force is beta * m_eff * penetration / dt^2. For a moving contact boundary, the equivalent nodal penalty uses the mapped nodal mass. Zero disables the penalty.

attributes.name: maxJammingStress
attributes.description: Optional rigid-event jamming-stress threshold. In each currently compressing direction, the minimum absolute reaction on the opposing faces is divided by the current end-of-step face area. The event completes when the largest opposed-face stress reaches maxJammingStress. If the deformation rate is zero, all active spatial directions are checked. Nonpositive values disable this criterion.

attributes.name: maxContactPenetration
attributes.description: Optional dimensionless maximum rigid-event contact penetration, including material-material and moving Contact-boundary penetration. The physical limit is maxContactPenetration times the current grid-cell diagonal: sqrt(hx^2+hy^2) in plane strain and sqrt(hx^2+hy^2+hz^2) in 3D. Negative values disable this safeguard. The event completes after the normalized limit is exceeded on two consecutive rigid-body steps.

attributes.name: contactPenetrationExceedanceCount
attributes.description: Internal count of consecutive rigid-body steps exceeding maxContactPenetration.

attributes.name: stopKineticEnergy
attributes.description: Optional event-completion kinetic-energy threshold. Negative disables this stop criterion.

attributes.name: maxForce
attributes.description: Optional event-completion maximum resultant body force. Negative disables this stop criterion.

attributes.name: minActiveTime
attributes.description: Minimum active time before optional RigidBodyMPM maxJammingStress, maxForce, or kinetic-energy stop criteria may complete the event. The maxContactPenetration safeguard is intentionally not delayed by minActiveTime.

attributes.name: writeHistory
attributes.description: Flag enabling rigid-body CSV history output.

attributes.name: historyWriteInterval
attributes.description: Time interval for rigidBodyHistory.csv. Zero writes every solver step.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: boundaryConditionTypes
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: | Boundary conditions on x-, x+, y-, y+, z- and z+ faces. Options are:

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: boxAverageHistory
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for whether to output box average history

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: cflFactor
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Factor to apply to the `CFL condition <http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy_condition>`_ when calculating the maximum allowable time step. Values should be in the interval (0,1]

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: contactGapCorrection
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for mitigating contact gaps

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: cpdiDomainScaling
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Option for CPDI domain scaling

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: damageFieldPartitioning
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for using the gradient of the particle damage field to partition material into separate velocity fields

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: discretization
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Name of discretization object (defined in the :ref:`NumericalMethodsManager`) to use for this solver. For instance, if this is a Finite Element Solver, the name of a :ref:`FiniteElement` should be specified. If this is a Finite Volume Method, the name of a :ref:`FiniteVolume` discretization should be specified.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: fTableInterpType
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: The type of F table interpolation. Options are 0 (linear), 1 (cosine), 2 (quintic polynomial).

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: frictionCoefficient
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Coefficient of friction, currently assumed to be the same everywhere

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: initialDt
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Initial time-step value required by the solver to the event manager.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: logLevel
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Log level

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: name
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: A name is required for any non-unique nodes

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: needsNeighborList
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for whether to construct neighbor list

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: neighborRadius
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Neighbor radius for SPH-type calculations

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: planeStrain
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for performing plane strain calculations

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: prescribedBcTable
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for whether to have time-dependent boundary condition types

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: prescribedBoundaryFTable
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for whether to have time-dependent boundary conditions described by a global background grid F

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: profileDirection
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Direction for MPM profile output. Valid values are x, y, and z.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: profileCycleInterval
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Cycle interval for MPM profile output. Use either profileCycleInterval or profileWriteInterval. A value of 0 means no cycle-based interval.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: profileHistory
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag to enable MPM profile CSV output. One CSV file is written per requested profile variable.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: profileNumSlices
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Number of profile slices. A value of 0 uses the background-grid resolution in profileDirection.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: profileVariables
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Variables to write to MPM profile CSV files. Supported names include density, damage, temperature, internalEnergy, kineticEnergy, velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ, volumeFraction, plasticStrainMagnitude, stressXX, stressYY, stressZZ, stressYZ, stressXZ, stressXY, and plasticStrainXX/YY/ZZ/YZ/XZ/XY.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: profileWriteInterval
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Time interval for MPM profile output. Use either profileWriteInterval or profileCycleInterval. A value of 0 means no time-based interval.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: reactionHistory
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for whether to output face reaction history

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: separabilityMinDamage
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Damage threshold for field separability

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: solverProfiling
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for timing subroutines in the solver

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: surfaceDetection
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Flag for automatic surface detection on the 1st cycle

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: targetRegions
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Allowable regions that the solver may be applied to. Note that this does not indicate that the solver will be applied to these regions, only that allocation will occur such that the solver may be applied to these regions. The decision about what regions this solver will beapplied to rests in the EventManager.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: treatFullyDamagedAsSingleField integer
SolidMechanics_MPM.default: Whether to consolidate fully damaged fields into a single field. Nice for modeling damaged mush.

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: writeLinearSystem
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: Write matrix, rhs, solution to screen ( = 1) or file ( = 2).

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: LinearSolverParameters
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: :ref:`XML_LinearSolverParameters`

SolidMechanics_MPM.name: NonlinearSolverParameters
SolidMechanics_MPM.description: :ref:`XML_NonlinearSolverParameters`
